rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases cannot exceed the lesser of 3% or 80% of the CPI change. The current maximum allowable increase is 2.87% for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.
rules.key_value: 2.87% for Sept 1, 2026 – Aug 31, 2027 (lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change)
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict, such as nonpayment of rent, breach of lease, or landlord move-in. Relocation assistance may be owed for certain no-fault evictions.
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
